title: GENCOLORBENCH: A COLOR EVALUATION BENCH MARK FOR TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using structured prompts that pair diverse objects with specific colors, then applying VQA-based object detection, segmentation, and pixel-level color extraction (Delta Chroma, CIEDE2000, MAE Hue) to measure how often models ignore the prompted color and default to overrepresented neutral tones (black, gray, brown) or canonical/biological object colors learned from training data priors.
